exposure: reason for radical hysterectomy (placenta percreta, ovarian cancer, cervical cancer)
dissection of avascular spaces during hysterectomy
cohort: 166 patients who underwent modified radical hysterectomy for placenta percreta, ovarian cancer, or cervical cancer across multiple centers.
finding: Dissection of avascular spaces during radical hysterectomy was associated with lower blood loss, and the risk of hemorrhage was highest in procedures performed for placenta percreta.
